content:
Studio Ghibli-inspired anime style, cinematic lighting, dynamic motion blur, particle effects (cherry blossoms and forest leaves), high frame rate action, Japanese fantasy setting, ultra detailed character design, 4K, smooth camera motion, epic orchestral score building tension to release

CHARACTER A: Sakura Voyager — young girl with long brown hair, red bow, red-and-teal floral kimono, riding a large fluffy white cat with a bell collar and beaded tassel harness

CHARACTER B: Shiranui — young girl with long black hair, white-and-green forest robes with red cord accents, riding a white wolf with red facial markings and a bell-and-tassel harness

---

[00:00–00:02] THE STANDOFF
Two young girls face each other on a stone bridge at the edge of an ancient forest at golden hour. Character A sits confidently atop her white cat on the left; Character B crouches low and tense atop her white wolf on the right, ears back, ready to spring. Wind stirs cherry blossoms and forest leaves in the space between them. Camera slowly pushes in from a low angle. A beat of tense silence before the burst.

[00:02–00:05] THE LAUNCH
Both mounts explode forward in opposite motion-blur streaks at the exact same instant. The white cat leaps with swirling wind-trail effects around its paws; the white wolf digs its claws into the ground, kicking up dirt and grass. Fast tracking shot from the side, slight camera shake to sell the speed, cherry blossoms and leaves scatter violently in their wake.

[00:05–00:09] THE CHASE
Side-by-side pursuit through a torii gate path transitioning into dense bamboo forest. Character A leans forward, ribbons and hair streaming behind her, bell jingling with every stride. Character B crouches low gripping the wolf's fur, eyes fierce and focused. Quick cross-cutting between each rider's point-of-view every second — trees blur past, wind roars, the wolf snarls with exertion. Rhythmic editing builds intensity.

[00:09–00:12] THE OBSTACLE
A narrow gap between two moss-covered boulders and a fallen torii beam appears ahead. Both racers reach it simultaneously — the cat leaps gracefully into the air over the gap, wind curling beneath its paws as if flying; the wolf ducks low and slides underneath at full speed, sparks and dust flying from its claws. Camera whips into a fast 180-degree orbit around the obstacle, capturing both actions in one continuous sweep.

[00:12–00:15] THE FINISH
Both racers burst out of the forest into an open sunlit clearing at the exact same moment, neck and neck, petals and leaves swirling together in the air around them. Camera freezes into a dramatic hero-shot composition as both girls glance at each other and break into a laugh, their mounts rearing slightly in triumph. Soft golden light flare. Elegant title text fades in: "WIND vs WILD". Slow-motion finish, music resolves on a final cymbal swell and a single clear bell chime.

---

0:00–0:02 — ambient wind, low string tension
0:02 — sudden percussive hit, race begins
0:05–0:12 — driving percussion and strings, tempo increasing
0:12 — music cuts sharply
0:13–0:15 — soft resolving chord, bell chime, wolf howl tail-off

COLOR CODING:
Character A (cat): warm reds, sakura pink, deep teal accents
Character B (wolf): cool grays, olive green, muted white
Use consistent color grading per character across cross-cut shots so viewers can instantly track who's who.

Persecución lado a lado a través de un camino de puertas torii que se transforma en un denso bosque de bambú. La cámara gira rápidamente en una órbita de 180 grados alrededor del obstáculo, capturando ambas acciones en un solo barrido continuo.

[00:12–00:15] EL FINAL
Ambos corredores salen del bosque hacia un claro iluminado por el sol en el mismo momento exacto, codo a codo, pétalos y hojas arremolinándose juntos en el aire a su alrededor. La cámara se congela en una composición dramática de toma heroica mientras ambas chicas se miran y se ríen, sus monturas se levantan ligeramente en triunfo. Destello de luz dorada suave. ---
スタジオジブリ風のアニメスタイル、シネマティックな照明、ダイナミックなモーションブラー、パーティクルエフェクト（桜の花びらと森の葉）、高フレームレートのアクション、日本のファンタジー設定、超詳細なキャラクターデザイン、4K、スムーズなカメラモーション、緊張を解放する壮大なオーケストラのスコア

キャラクターA: 桜ボイジャー — 長い茶色の髪を持つ若い少女、赤いリボン、赤とティールの花柄の着物、大きなふわふわの白い猫に乗っている、鈴の首輪とビーズのタッセルハーネス

キャラクターB: 白ぬい — 長い黒髪を持つ若い少女、白と緑の森のローブに赤いコードのアクセント、赤い顔のマーキングがある白い狼に乗っている、鈴とタッセルのハーネス

---

[00:00–00:02] 対峙
黄金の時間帯に古代の森の端にある石橋で、二人の若い少女が向かい合う。キャラクターAは左側で白い猫の上に自信を持って座り、キャラクターBは右側で白い狼の上に低く身をかがめ、耳を後ろに倒して緊張している。風が二人の間で桜の花びらと森の葉を揺らす。カメラは低い角度からゆっくりと寄っていく。爆発前の緊張した沈黙の一瞬。

[00:02–00:05] 発進
両方の乗り物が正反対のモーションブラーのストリークで同時に爆発的に前進する。白い猫はその足の周りに渦巻く風のトレイルエフェクトを伴って跳び、白い狼は地面に爪を食い込ませ、土と草を蹴り上げる。側面からの高速トラッキングショット、スピードを演出するためのわずかなカメラシェイク、彼らの後ろで桜の花びらと葉が激しく散る。

[00:05–00:09] 追跡
鳥居の道を通り抜け、密集した竹林に移行する並走追跡。キャラクターAは前に身を乗り出し、リボンと髪が後ろに流れ、鈴が一歩ごとに鳴る。キャラクターBは狼の毛をしっかりと握り、目は鋭く集中している。毎秒ごとに各ライダーの視点を素早くクロスカット — 木々がぼやけて過ぎ去り、風が轟き、狼が力を込めて唸る。リズミカルな編集が緊張感を高める。

[00:09–00:12] 障害物
苔むした二つの巨石と倒れた鳥居の梁の間の狭い隙間が前方に現れる。両方のレーサーが同時に到達 — 猫は優雅に空中に跳び、風がその足の下で巻き上がり、飛んでいるかのように見える。狼は低く身をかがめ、全速力で下を滑り抜け、爪から火花と埃が飛び散る。カメラは障害物の周りを高速で180度回転し、一連の動作を一つの連続したスイープで捉える。

[00:12–00:15] フィニッシュ
両方のレーサーが森を抜けて日光が差し込む開けた空き地に同時に飛び出し、首を並べて、花びらと葉が彼らの周りで渦巻く。カメラはドラマチックなヒーローショットの構図で凍りつき、両方の少女が互いに目を合わせて笑い出し、彼らの乗り物がわずかに勝利のポーズを取る。柔らかな黄金の光のフレア。優雅なタイトルテキストがフェードイン: "WIND vs WILD"。スローモーションのフィニッシュ、音楽は最終的なシンバルの膨らみと一つの澄んだ鈴の音で解決する。

황금 시간대에 고대 숲 가장자리의 돌다리 위에서 두 어린 소녀가 서로 마주보고 있다. 캐릭터 A는 왼쪽에서 흰 고양이 위에 자신감 있게 앉아 있고; 캐릭터 B는 오른쪽에서 흰 늑대 위에 낮고 긴장된 자세로 웅크리고 있으며, 귀를 뒤로 젖히고 도약할 준비를 하고 있다. 바람이 그들 사이에서 벚꽃과 숲의 잎을 휘젓는다. 카메라는 낮은 각도에서 천천히 밀어 들어간다. 폭발 전의 긴장된 침묵의 순간.

[00:02–00:05] 출발
두 탈것이 정확히 같은 순간에 반대 방향으로 모션 블러 스트릭으로 폭발한다. 흰 고양이는 발 주위에 소용돌이치는 바람 효과와 함께 뛰어오르고; 흰 늑대는 발톱을 땅에 박고 흙과 풀을 차올린다. 측면에서 빠른 추적 샷, 속도를 강조하기 위한 약간의 카메라 흔들림, 벚꽃과 잎이 그들의 뒤에서 격렬하게 흩어진다.

이끼로 덮인 두 바위 사이의 좁은 틈과 쓰러진 토리이 빔이 앞에 나타난다. 두 경주자는 동시에 도착한다 — 고양이는 틈 위로 우아하게 공중으로 뛰어오르고, 발 아래 바람이 말려들어 마치 날고 있는 듯하다; 늑대는 낮게 몸을 숙이고 전속력으로 아래로 미끄러져 들어가며, 발톱에서 불꽃과 먼지가 날린다. 카메라는 장애물을 빠르게 180도 회전하며 두 동작을 하나의 연속적인 스윕으로 포착한다.

두 경주자는 숲을 빠져나와 햇빛이 비치는 개활지로 동시에 튀어나오며, 목과 목을 맞대고, 꽃잎과 잎이 그들 주위에 함께 소용돌이친다. 카메라는 극적인 히어로 샷 구도로 얼어붙고, 두 소녀는 서로를 보고 웃음을 터뜨리며, 그들의 탈것은 약간 승리의 자세를 취한다. 부드러운 황금빛 빛이 번쩍인다. 우아한 제목 텍스트가 서서히 나타난다: "WIND vs WILD". 슬로우 모션 피니시, 음악은 마지막 심벌즈 스웰과 단일한 맑은 종소리로 마무리된다.

PERSONAGEM B: Shiranui — jovem garota com longos cabelos pretos, vestes de floresta brancas e verdes com detalhes em cordão vermelho, montando um lobo branco com marcas faciais vermelhas e arreio de sino e borlas

[00:00–00:02] O CONFRONTO
Duas jovens garotas se enfrentam em uma ponte de pedra na borda de uma floresta antiga ao pôr do sol. A Personagem A está sentada confiante no topo de seu gato branco à esquerda; a Personagem B está agachada, baixa e tensa, no topo de seu lobo branco à direita, orelhas para trás, pronta para saltar. O vento agita flores de cerejeira e folhas da floresta no espaço entre elas. A câmera avança lentamente de um ângulo baixo. Um momento de silêncio tenso antes da explosão.

[00:02–00:05] O LANÇAMENTO
Ambas as montarias explodem para frente em listras de desfoque de movimento opostas no exato mesmo instante. O gato branco salta com efeitos de trilha de vento rodopiando ao redor de suas patas; o lobo branco crava suas garras no chão, levantando terra e grama. Tomada de rastreamento rápido de lado, leve tremor de câmera para vender a velocidade, flores de cerejeira e folhas se espalham violentamente em seu rastro.

[00:05–00:09] A PERSEGUIÇÃO
Perseguição lado a lado através de um caminho de portões torii que transita para uma densa floresta de bambu. A Personagem A se inclina para frente, fitas e cabelos esvoaçando atrás dela, sino tilintando a cada passada. A Personagem B se agacha, segurando o pelo do lobo, olhos ferozes e focados. Corte rápido entre o ponto de vista de cada cavaleira a cada segundo — árvores passam borradas, o vento ruge, o lobo rosna com esforço. Edição rítmica aumenta a intensidade.

Uma brecha estreita entre duas pedras cobertas de musgo e uma viga de torii caída aparece à frente. Ambas as competidoras chegam simultaneamente — o gato salta graciosamente no ar sobre a brecha, vento se enrolando sob suas patas como se estivesse voando; o lobo se abaixa e desliza por baixo em alta velocidade, faíscas e poeira voando de suas garras. A câmera gira rapidamente em uma órbita de 180 graus ao redor do obstáculo, capturando ambas as ações em um movimento contínuo.

[00:12–00:15] A CHEGADA
Ambas as competidoras irrompem da floresta para uma clareira ensolarada no exato mesmo momento, lado a lado, pétalas e folhas rodopiando juntas no ar ao redor delas. A câmera congela em uma composição dramática de herói enquanto ambas as garotas se olham e começam a rir, suas montarias empinando levemente em triunfo. Flare de luz dourada suave. Texto elegante do título aparece: "WIND vs WILD". Final em câmera lenta, música se resolve em um último crescendo de prato e um único toque claro de sino.

受吉卜力工作室启发的动漫风格，电影级灯光，动态运动模糊，粒子效果（樱花和森林树叶），高帧率动作，日本幻想背景，超精细角色设计，4K，流畅的镜头运动，史诗管弦乐配乐，紧张感逐渐释放

角色A：樱花航行者——年轻女孩，长棕色头发，红色蝴蝶结，红色和青绿色花纹和服，骑着一只大而蓬松的白猫，带有铃铛项圈和珠饰流苏马具

角色B：不知火——年轻女孩，长黑色头发，白色和绿色森林长袍，红色绳索装饰，骑着一只白狼，脸上有红色标记，带有铃铛和流苏马具

---

[00:00–00:02] 对峙
两名年轻女孩在古老森林边缘的石桥上对峙，正值黄金时刻。角色A自信地坐在左侧的白猫上；角色B低身紧张地蹲在右侧的白狼上，耳朵向后，准备跃起。风在她们之间的空间中搅动樱花和森林树叶。镜头从低角度缓缓推进。紧张的沉默后爆发。

[00:02–00:05] 起跑
两只坐骑在同一瞬间以相反的运动模糊轨迹爆发前进。白猫跃起，爪子周围有旋风轨迹效果；白狼将爪子扎进地面，扬起尘土和草屑。侧面快速跟踪镜头，轻微的镜头抖动以表现速度，樱花和树叶在她们的尾迹中剧烈散开。

[00:05–00:09] 追逐
并肩穿过鸟居门道，进入密集的竹林。角色A向前倾，丝带和头发在身后飘扬，每一步都伴随着铃铛声。角色B低身紧握狼的皮毛，眼神凶狠而专注。每秒快速交叉剪辑每个骑手的视角——树木模糊掠过，风声呼啸，狼因用力而咆哮。节奏化的剪辑增强了紧张感。

[00:09–00:12] 障碍
前方出现两块布满苔藓的巨石和一根倒下的鸟居横梁之间的狭窄缝隙。两名竞速者同时到达——猫优雅地跃入空中越过缝隙，风在其爪下卷曲如同飞翔；狼低身全速滑过，爪子迸出火花和尘土。镜头快速180度环绕障碍，连续捕捉两者动作。

[00:12–00:15] 终点
两名竞速者同时从森林中冲出，进入阳光明媚的空地，齐头并进，花瓣和树叶在她们周围的空气中旋转。镜头定格成戏剧性的英雄镜头构图，两名女孩互相对视并笑了起来，她们的坐骑微微抬起以示胜利。柔和的金色光晕。优雅的标题文字渐显：“风与野”。慢动作结束，音乐在最后的钹声和清脆的铃声中结束。

---

音频提示：
0:00–0:02 — 环境风声，低弦紧张
0:02 — 突然的打击声，比赛开始
0:05–0:12 — 激昂的打击乐和弦乐，节奏加快
0:12 — 音乐急剧停止
0:13–0:15 — 柔和的和弦结束，铃声，狼嚎尾声

色彩编码：
角色A（猫）：温暖的红色，樱花粉，深青色点缀
角色B（狼）：冷灰色，橄榄绿，柔和的白色
在交叉剪辑镜头中使用一致的色彩分级，以便观众能立即识别角色。

--- 线程继续 ---
[线程1] 1️⃣故事板：

在干净的编辑布局上创建一个专业的16:9动画故事板表。大标题“15秒故事板”，项目名称“风与野”，制作信息（受吉卜力工作室启发的动漫，15秒，16:9）。右上角包括两个小角色卡：骑着蓬松白猫的樱花航行者（温暖的红/粉色调）和骑着巨型白狼的不知火（冷白/绿色调）。将8个故事板面板精确排列成4×2网格，每个面板都有编号标签、时间戳、电影插图、粗体场景标题、动作/对话行和音效行。故事：（1）比赛前在古老神社的对峙。（2）同时起跑。（3）穿过竹林和鸟居门的高速追逐。（4）猫跳过鸟居，而狼从下面冲过。（5）樱花的特写视角。（6）不知火的特写视角。（7）在金色夕阳下的最后冲刺。（8）两人同时冲过终点，竞争转化为樱花飘落下的友谊。底部包括一个专业的音频提示时间线，跨越完整的15秒。风格：受吉卜力工作室启发的动漫，电影级故事板，皮克斯/梦工厂制作展示，画风渲染，电影级灯光，动态运动模糊，专业排版，编辑布局，杰作，超精细，8K。

[线程2] 2️⃣视频提示：

Studio Ghibli-inspired anime style, cinematic lighting, dynamic motion blur, particle effects (cherry blossoms and forest leaves), high frame rate action, Japanese fantasy setting, ultra detailed character design, 4K, smooth camera motion, epic orchestral score building tension to release

CHARACTER A: Sakura Voyager — young girl with long brown hair, red bow, red-and-teal floral kimono, riding a large fluffy white cat with a bell collar and beaded tassel harness

CHARACTER B: Shiranui — young girl with long black hair, white-and-green forest robes with red cord accents, riding a white wolf with red facial markings and a bell-and-tassel harness

---

[00:00–00:02] THE STANDOFF
Two young girls face each other on a stone bridge at the edge of an ancient forest at golden hour. Character A sits confidently atop her white cat on the left; Character B crouches low and tense atop her white wolf on the right, ears back, ready to spring. Wind stirs cherry blossoms and forest leaves in the space between them. Camera slowly pushes in from a low angle. A beat of tense silence before the burst.

[00:02–00:05] THE LAUNCH
Both mounts explode forward in opposite motion-blur streaks at the exact same instant. The white cat leaps with swirling wind-trail effects around its paws; the white wolf digs its claws into the ground, kicking up dirt and grass. Fast tracking shot from the side, slight camera shake to sell the speed, cherry blossoms and leaves scatter violently in their wake.

[00:05–00:09] THE CHASE
Side-by-side pursuit through a torii gate path transitioning into dense bamboo forest. Character A leans forward, ribbons and hair streaming behind her, bell jingling with every stride. Character B crouches low gripping the wolf's fur, eyes fierce and focused. Quick cross-cutting between each rider's point-of-view every second — trees blur past, wind roars, the wolf snarls with exertion. Rhythmic editing builds intensity.

[00:09–00:12] THE OBSTACLE
A narrow gap between two moss-covered boulders and a fallen torii beam appears ahead. Both racers reach it simultaneously — the cat leaps gracefully into the air over the gap, wind curling beneath its paws as if flying; the wolf ducks low and slides underneath at full speed, sparks and dust flying from its claws. Camera whips into a fast 180-degree orbit around the obstacle, capturing both actions in one continuous sweep.

[00:12–00:15] THE FINISH
Both racers burst out of the forest into an open sunlit clearing at the exact same moment, neck and neck, petals and leaves swirling together in the air around them. Camera freezes into a dramatic hero-shot composition as both girls glance at each other and break into a laugh, their mounts rearing slightly in triumph. Soft golden light flare.
